name: homelab-mcp-server

tools.name: pct_exec
tools.description: Run a command inside an LXC container via pct exec

command.description: Command to run inside the container

confirm.description: Required true to run an availability-class (CONFIRM-tier) command inside the guest

tools.name: pct_list
tools.description: List LXC containers and their status via pct list

tools.name: revert_file
tools.description: Restore a file on the Proxmox host to a previous version from a local backup blob. Pass the backupPath returned by a prior write_file call (or from list_backups).

backupPath.description: Local path to the backup blob (the backupPath returned by a prior write_file/pct_write_file call)

path.description: Optional. If supplied, must match the path recorded in the backup metadata; otherwise the target is resolved from the backup itself.

tools.name: list_backups
tools.description: List available backup versions for a file on the Proxmox host. Returns each version's backupPath, timestamp, kind, size, and whether it is revertible.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to list backups for

vmid.description: If set, scope the query to a container file (pct:<vmid>:<path>) instead of a host file

tools.name: describe_homelab
tools.description: Read-only homelab census: walks the Proxmox node via a fixed set of probe commands and returns a structured, secret-redacted inventory (node, storage, network, containers, vms, services, tailscale). Optionally persists a snapshot and reports drift vs the previous one. No caller-supplied commands.

sections.description: Sections to include; defaults to all

depth.description: summary (default): identity + status; full: includes redacted per-guest config

compareToPrevious.description: Include a drift diff vs the latest stored snapshot

tools.name: pct_read_file
tools.description: Read a file from inside an LXC container (binary-safe via pct pull). Requires the container to be running.

path.description: Absolute path of the file inside the container

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from (for windowed reads of large files)

maxBytes.description: Maximum bytes to read in this window (bounded by the server's read cap)

tools.name: pct_write_file
tools.description: Write/overwrite a file inside an LXC container (via pct push). Backs up the prior version, preserves the existing file's permissions and owner, and appends an audit log entry. Requires the container to be running.

path.description: Absolute path of the file inside the container

dryRun.description: Preview only: returns a unified diff + would-be metadata. No push, no backup, no audit.

tools.name: snapshot_create
tools.description: Create a server-managed (mcp-) snapshot of a guest (LXC or VM). Auto-detects guest type. Enforces a per-guest retention cap, deleting the oldest mcp- snapshot first if needed. Use before a risky operation; delete on success or roll back on failure.

note.description: Optional description recorded on the snapshot and in the audit log

tools.name: snapshot_list
tools.description: List snapshots for a guest (LXC or VM), flagging which are server-managed (mcp-).

tools.name: snapshot_rollback
tools.description: Roll a guest back to a server-managed (mcp-) snapshot. DESTRUCTIVE: discards all guest state since the snapshot. Requires confirm: true. Only mcp-* snapshots are eligible. A running guest is refused unless stopIfRunning: true. NOTE: VM snapshots are taken without RAM state by default, so a VM rollback is disk-only — the guest resumes as if from power loss, not from the snapshot moment.

name.description: Snapshot name to roll back to (must be an mcp-* snapshot)

confirm.description: Must be true. Rollback discards ALL guest state since the snapshot.

stopIfRunning.description: If the guest is running, stop it, roll back, then restart it. If false, a running guest is refused.

tools.name: snapshot_delete
tools.description: Delete a server-managed (mcp-) snapshot of a guest. Only mcp-* snapshots are eligible; human-made snapshots are protected.

name.description: Snapshot name to delete (must be an mcp-* snapshot)

tools.name: qm_list
tools.description: List QEMU/KVM virtual machines and their status via qm list.

tools.name: qm_agent_ping
tools.description: Check whether a VM's QEMU guest agent is responsive (qm agent <vmid> ping). Returns { available, error? }; agent-dependent tools require this to pass.

tools.name: qm_exec
tools.description: Run a command inside a VM via the QEMU guest agent (qm guest exec). Requires the guest agent (qemu-guest-agent) to be installed and running. The inner command passes the same two-tier denylist as execute/pct_exec; CONFIRM-tier commands require confirm: true. Honest exit semantics: a non-terminating agent timeout cannot guarantee in-guest kill.

command.description: Command to run inside the VM via the QEMU guest agent

timeoutMs.description: Optional agent wait-timeout override in milliseconds

confirm.description: Required true to run an availability-class (CONFIRM-tier) command inside the guest

tools.name: qm_read_file
tools.description: Read a file from inside a VM via the QEMU guest agent (agent/file-read). Requires the guest agent. Text-oriented (binary is lossy); enforces the same read cap + offset/maxBytes window as read_file/pct_read_file. For large files use offset/maxBytes or qm_exec with head/tail/grep/wc.

path.description: Absolute path of the file inside the VM

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from (for windowed reads of large files)

maxBytes.description: Maximum bytes to read in this window (bounded by the server's read cap)

tools.name: qm_write_file
tools.description: Write a file inside a VM via the QEMU guest agent (agent/file-write). Requires the guest agent. Runs the full backup + audit pipeline (dryRun previews a diff with no side effects). Bounded by the guest-agent write cap; no permission preservation (file lands with the guest's default umask).

path.description: Absolute path of the file inside the VM

dryRun.description: Preview only: returns a unified diff + would-be metadata. No write, no backup, no audit.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Read-only node health check: runs a fixed set of probes (load, memory, ZFS, filesystem/storage usage, failed systemd units, onboot-but-stopped guests, pending apt updates) and rolls them up to ok/warn/crit against configured thresholds. Sections are error-isolated; apt staleness is read via apt-get -s (simulate), never apt update.

sections.description: Sections to probe; defaults to all (node, storage, guests, units, updates)

tools.name: tail_log
tools.description: Read the tail of a systemd unit journal (journalctl) or a log file (tail), on the host or inside an LXC container. Strict input validation (unit charset, since grammar, path allowlist, line cap). Output ALWAYS passes through secret redaction before return.

target.description: Where to read: the Proxmox host, or inside an LXC container

unit.description: systemd unit to read via journalctl (exclusive with path)

path.description: absolute log file path to tail (exclusive with unit)

lines.description: number of trailing lines (clamped to the cap)

since.description: time filter: ISO timestamp or relative like "30 min ago" (unit mode only)

tools.name: query_audit
tools.description: Query the local audit log. Filter by tool, vmid, path substring, time range, or large-change flag; returns a summary (counts by tool/vmid, time span) plus the newest-first matching records (bounded by a configurable limit). Read-only, not itself audited.

tool.description: Filter by audit tool name (e.g. write_file, qm_exec)

pathContains.description: Substring match on the record path

tools.name: diff_config
tools.description: Preview what reverting a file would change: reconstructs a backup's content and diffs it against the file's current content (current → backup). Resolve by backupPath, or by path (+vmid for containers) to use the latest backup. Read-only, not audited; the revert it precedes is what gets logged.

backupPath.description: Local path to a specific backup blob/.meta. If omitted, the latest backup for `path` is used.

path.description: Target file path. Required when `backupPath` is omitted; resolves the latest backup for this file.

vmid.description: Container VMID when the target is an LXC file (used only with `path`).

inputSchema.description: Preview the diff between a backup and the file's current content. Read-only, not audited.

tools.name: guest_start
tools.description: Start a guest (LXC container or VM) by vmid. API-native operate-tier control; the guest type is auto-detected. Audited.

tools.name: guest_stop
tools.description: Stop a guest (LXC container or VM) by vmid. Confirm-gated: a stop is an immediate power-off, not a graceful shutdown. Use guest_restart for a graceful cycle. Audited.

confirm.description: Must be true. A stop is an immediate power-off; in-guest processes are not shut down gracefully.

tools.name: guest_restart
tools.description: Restart a guest (LXC container or VM) by vmid via a graceful reboot (shutdown + start). Auto-detects guest type. Audited.
